claire: quick PR heads-up — adding a 'tier mapping' section + compact SDK examples for per-request tier headers and analytics export. need quick sanity check.

oscar: drop the examples pls.

claire: js snippet:

```js
await client.generate({
  model: 'redwood-13b',
  input: 'Draft an email',
  headers: {
    'X-Redwood-Tier': 'team-plus',
    'X-Redwood-Fallback': 'auto-economy'
  }
})
```

mina: add a minimal analytics export example and call out the rename tier_label->usage_tier

claire: analytics example:

```json
{"usage":[{"meter":"tokens","usage_tier":"team-plus","count":1200},{"meter":"burst_credits","usage_tier":"legacy-grant","count":20}]}
```

oscar: include console link template: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboard/usage_migration?team={{team_id}} (requires console:usage-read)

claire: done. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5170 reviewers: @oscar @mina
